title: "Data"

## Releases

`childes-db` is updated periodically with a fresh parse of the CHILDES
database, to reflect new corpora and to revise existing annotations (see the
[documentation](docs.html) for details). Releases may also include new
features — for example, 2020.1 introduced coverage of corpora from
[PhonBank](https://phonbank.talkbank.org). Visualizations on this site use the
most recent release; the R API `childesr` and the Python API `childespy` can
be directed to any release via their `version` parameter.

```{=html}
<table class="releases-table">
  <tr><th>Version</th><th>Notes</th></tr>
  <tr><td>2018.1</td><td>Initial release.</td></tr>
  <tr><td>2019.1</td><td>Re-parsed to reflect 2019 changes in CHILDES. Note
    that this excludes key datasets like Providence which were moved to
    PhonBank.</td></tr>
  <tr><td>2020.1</td><td>Re-parsed to reflect 2020 changes in CHILDES, as well
    as the 2020 version of PhonBank.</td></tr>
  <tr><td>2021.1</td><td>Re-parsed to reflect 2021 changes in CHILDES and
    PhonBank, using a new version of the corpus processing code and a better
    set of tests.</td></tr>
</table>
```

## Accessing the data

- **R**: the [childesr](https://langcog.github.io/childesr/) package provides
  tidy accessors for collections, corpora, participants, transcripts,
  utterances, and tokens.
- **Python**: the [childespy](https://pypi.org/project/childespy/) package
  provides the same interface from Python.
- **SQL**: both packages connect to a hosted MySQL database, which can also be
  queried directly.

## Using childes-db locally

For intensive use cases (e.g., repeatedly transferring more than 5 GB of
data), you may wish to download a yearly release for installation on a local
MySQL server. Releases can be transferred with `mysqldump`:

```
mysqldump -v -u $USER -p$PASSWORD -h $HOST --single-transaction \
  --no-tablespaces -C --quick --databases $DATABASES | \
  mysql -u $LOCAL_USER -p$LOCAL_PASSWORD
```

Depending on your `mysqlclient` version, you might have to add the
`--column-statistics=0` option. Connection parameters (host, user, password)
are those used by the R and Python APIs, published in
[childes-db.json](childes-db.json); each yearly release is around 40 GB.
Once you have a local installation, see the `childesr` or `childespy`
documentation for pointing the API at a local database server. For most use
cases, the default remote server is sufficient.

## Citation

If you use `childes-db`, please note the database version you used (e.g.,
`2021.1`) and cite both [our paper](https://link.springer.com/article/10.3758/s13428-018-1176-7)
and CHILDES itself — both the database and the corpora you use — following the
[TalkBank policy](https://talkbank.org/share/citation.html). See
[About](about.html) for the full citation policy.
